description: PrimeVue 4 (and the v3 names still found in apps) to @aisgroup/design. Each entry: from (component, directive, service or setup piece), import, to (registry names), status, props (PrimeVue prop or usage: what replaces it), needs (components being added to the package), notes; useToast and useConfirm also carry a bridge, a file that keeps PrimeVue's call shape over ours while a large app's callers move. A full redesign removes PrimeVue; the adapters in packages/vue-themes are only a bridge for screens not yet moved.

statuses.direct: A counterpart exists: swap the component and map the props.
statuses.compose: No single counterpart: build it from the listed components.
statuses.gap: No counterpart, even after the components being added. The notes say what the library needs and how to compose a temporary version.
statuses.remove: PrimeVue-only behaviour or setup: delete it. The notes say what replaces it under our rules.
